sections.title: Please and you're welcome
sections.content: *Kérem* means "please" — tack it onto a request to make it politer, or use it alone to accept something offered. *Szívesen* is the standard reply to *köszönöm* ("thank you"), matching English "you're welcome".

*Kérem* is also literally "I ask for [it]" — the polite word for "please" and the verb for asking are the same word wearing two hats. That's why it works standing completely alone as an answer, too: offered something and you want it, *kérem* on its own means "please, yes."
